title: Normalize PipeWire application and device metadata
description:
Create PropertyNormalizer, a stateless utility that extracts and normalizes human-readable display names, application identifiers, device labels, and icon names from raw PipeWire spa_dict property bags.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- PipeWire property keys in pipewire/keys.h (PW_KEY_APP_NAME, PW_KEY_APP_ICON_NAME, PW_KEY_MEDIA_NAME, PW_KEY_NODE_DESCRIPTION, PW_KEY_NODE_NICK, PW_KEY_NODE_NAME, PW_KEY_DEVICE_NICK, PW_KEY_DEVICE_DESCRIPTION)
- spa/dict.h for spa_dict and spa_dict_lookup
- src/pipewire/SourceDescriptor.hpp for the SourceDescriptor fields this normalizer will populate

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implementation:
1. PropertyNormalizer.hpp — declare a namespace or struct PropertyNormalizer with static/free functions: std::string extractDisplayName(const spa_dict* props) that tries PW_KEY_NODE_DESCRIPTION → PW_KEY_NODE_NICK → PW_KEY_NODE_NAME → PW_KEY_APP_NAME with fallback to "Unknown"; std::string extractAppName(const spa_dict* props); std::string extractMediaClass(const spa_dict* props); std::optional<uint32_t> extractDeviceId(const spa_dict* props); std::string extractIconName(const spa_dict* props). Declare std::string sanitizeUtf8(std::string_view raw) to strip control characters and ensure valid UTF-8 for UI display.
2. PropertyNormalizer.cpp — implement each extractor using spa_dict_lookup with the documented fallback chains. extractDeviceId parses the string property to uint32_t safely. sanitizeUtf8 removes C0/C1 control characters (except space) and replaces invalid UTF-8 sequences with U+FFFD. All functions are pure: no PipeWire connection, no state, no allocation beyond return values.

Constraints:
- All functions must be stateless and thread-safe (no mutable static data).
- Do not depend on PipeWireContext; only depend on PipeWire/SPA headers for type definitions.
- Handle nullptr spa_dict gracefully (return empty/nullopt, no throw).
acceptance_criteria: src/pipewire/PropertyNormalizer.hpp declares extractDisplayName, extractAppName, extractMediaClass, extractDeviceId, extractIconName, and sanitizeUtf8
src/pipewire/PropertyNormalizer.cpp implements property extraction with documented fallback chains using spa_dict_lookup
All PropertyNormalizer functions handle nullptr spa_dict input without crashing or throwing
sanitizeUtf8 strips control characters and replaces invalid UTF-8 sequences
PropertyNormalizer does not include or depend on PipeWireContext.hpp
g++ -std=c++20 -fsyntax-only -I/usr/include/pipewire-0.3 -I/usr/include/spa-0.2 src/pipewire/PropertyNormalizer.hpp succeeds or the file is parseable as valid C++20 with SPA headers
